sentences.en: I'll bet Madonna doesn't return to her career for awhile.
sentences.zh: 我打赌麦当娜不会马上回到她的事业中。

sentences.en: I'll bet that I can beat you to the tree.
sentences.zh: 我打赌我能比你先到树下。

sentences.en: I made a bet that she would win the game.
sentences.zh: 我打赌她会赢得这场比赛。
